rules: The one retained CCEL ThML member must match the manifest bytes, physical-line count, UTF-8 decoding, and SHA-256.
Every retained physical line must be represented exactly once in source order and bound to its exact source byte interval.

The parsed ThML root, head, body, four ordered div1 carriers, 11 content div2 roots including one Section and ten Chapter roots, 79 nested div3 sections, six index roots, and complete element-tag census must match independent source traversal.
The candidate must be TEI P5 schema-valid, nonaccepted, and bound to this manifest and profile.
The independent oracle must reject source drift, topology drift, accountability mutation, TEI line mutation, provenance mutation, and unresolved-boundary mutation.
Technical validation does not establish human acceptance, rights clearance, accepted IR, CVW review, metadata adoption, or publication authorization.
